text:
Maya: Quick sweep — noticed the webinar registration curve dipped this morning while paid inbound spiked, can someone pull the dashboard and confirm if attribution windows shifted?
Jordan: On it. Pulled pulseboard -> looks like last 12h sample rate dropped to 30% from 70% for 'utm_campaign'. Suspect tag stripping in redirect.
Sam: Oof, that would break attribution. Any changes to the landing redirect rule earlier?
Ali: I deployed a small change to the campaign redirect at 03:10 UTC to add a 301 -> 302 fallback. I flagged to QA but maybe headers got stripped.
Maya: Can you paste the deploy link/PR? we need to see exact diff.
Ali: https://git.redwood/marketing/redirects/commit/4b7f8df — the change was one-line in nginx config.
MetricsBot: Daily KPI snapshot: registrations=1,240 (-18% 24h), paid_inbound=842 (+27% 24h), attributed_paid=512 (-40% 24h)
Jordan: The pulseboard query for attributed_paid relies on presence of utm_campaign and gclid in the request; if the redirect lost querystring we lose attribution and traffic gets lumped into 'direct/unknown'.
Sam: We should cross-check raw access logs. Ali, can you confirm whether your redirect preserves querystring for 302?
Ali: 302 should preserve, but my test shows nginx location block used 'return 302' without $request_uri — my bad, it returned bare path. Fixing now.
Leah: Timeline: can we patch and reprocess last 6h of events for attribution? We need accurate numbers for today's KPI review at 3pm PT.
Maya: If we can reprocess, prioritize webinar registration attribution specifically. Also need to surface which campaigns lost credit so PMs can decide if we re-run emails.
Jordan: Reprocessing pipeline: archive raw events -> run attribution job with preserved querystrings. If Ali pushes fix in the next 20m, we can reprocess a rolling window back to 00:00 UTC. Expect ~45m job.
Ali: Patch pushed, PR 512 merged, nginx reload done. Verified locally: querystring preserved now.
MetricsBot: Reprocess job queued (job_id=rp-2026-03-21-09). Estimated time 35 mins.
Sam: I'll run a quick check on cohort diffs post-reprocess and flag any ads that lost >30% credit.
Leah: Also we need to update the webinar readout deck slide 4 with the corrected registration attribution and note the pipeline incident in the footnote.
Maya: Thanks. Assign owners: Ali = rollback/patch verification, Jordan = dashboard query validation, Sam = reprocess QA + cohort diffs, Leah = deck update + comms. Ping me if anything blocks.
Jordan: Found one dashboard alert misconfigured: sample_rate_ratio used 7d baseline instead of 24h. Tweaking threshold so we don't get noisy alerts.
Ali: Verified corrected registrations are backfilling — first batch shows attributed_paid rising from 512 -> 780.
Maya: Nice. If numbers stabilize, we'll keep the webinar go/no-go as scheduled. Leah, once deck updated, can you drop it in #all-hands and tag sales?
Leah: Yep will do. ETA slide update + handoff in 50m. :thumbsup: 
Sam: Post-reprocess checks passing, small residual delta on two paid channels, looks like ~12% loss that likely came from late click windows. I'll add notes to the ticket.
Maya: Great work team. Can we add a follow-up to limit nginx change approvals for campaign redirects? I want a preflight checklist.
Jordan: Agreed — will draft a checklist and add to the playbook.
MetricsBot: Job rp-2026-03-21-09 completed. Backfilled 00:00-09:00 UTC. New snapshot: registrations=1,760 (+9% corrected), attributed_paid=1,020 (+99% corrected)
Maya: That's perfect. Closing thread after deck update. Thanks everyone :rocket:
